title: Universal Platform UI/UX Polish, Google M3 Layouts, Native Mobile/Tablet App UX & Missing Options Census (Strict 99+/100 Elite Gate)
spec:
### 1. OBJECTIVE & MANDATE
Execute an exhaustive, platform-wide UI/UX enhancement, popup redesign, layout margin/padding calibration, and logic integration overhaul across all 4 portals (Candidate, Employer/Recruiter, Enterprise, SuperAdmin).
Strict Quality Gate: Approval and Certification will ONLY be granted after achieving a verified score of 99+/100 against real-DOM visual, aesthetic, and functional criteria.

### 2. FIVE USER-IDENTIFIED DEFECT CLUSTERS & CORE REQUIREMENTS

1. CLUSTER 1: EXECUTIVE DROPDOWNS & POPUPS REDESIGN
   - User Profile Dropdown (M3UserMenu.jsx): Eliminate text clipping/truncation in identity chip and popover panel. Upgrade container to Cuba executive glassmorphism (cuba-glass, border-cuba-header-menu-border, shadow-cuba-xl, rounded-2xl). Add refined hover states, micro-interactions, clean separators, and role-scoped navigational targets.
   - Notifications Popover (M3NotificationCenter.jsx): Replace hardcoded repetitive dummy strings ('New message. You have a new message. 18h ago') with realistic, contextual platform activity feed. Replace default Windows grey scrollbar with sleek Cuba custom scrollbar tokens (scrollbar-thin scrollbar-thumb-slate-300 dark:scrollbar-thumb-slate-700). Enhance header and empty state styling.
   - AI Engine Status Beacon: Fix root cause of 'AI Engine Status Unknown' in top navbar. Update /api/service-availability on backend to emit real AI provider operational telemetry (payload.ai) so useAiEngineStatus correctly reflects 'AI Engine Ready' when configured.

2. CLUSTER 2: DASHBOARD LAYOUTS, PADDING & MARGIN CALIBRATION
   - Eliminate awkward edge-to-edge card stretching. Enforce uniform responsive container gutters (max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6) across Candidate, Employer, Enterprise, and Admin dashboards.
   - EmployerDashboard.jsx / JobPostings: Refactor job cards from flat border cards into premium Cuba cards (cuba-card, rounded-xl, hover:shadow-cuba-md). Provide proper typographic hierarchy and replace raw unstyled fallback strings ('Salary not specified', 'Posted Date not specified') with elegant contextual badges/chips.

3. CLUSTER 3: ELIMINATION OF NATIVE BROWSER DIALOGS (ZERO alert())
   - JobApplicationsModal.jsx & throughout codebase: Completely ban native window.alert(), window.confirm(), and window.prompt(). Replace alert('Resume link not available') and any fallback alerts with Cuba toast notifications (showToast / toast.error) or an executive modal dialog.

4. CLUSTER 4: ELIMINATION OF DATE LOGIC BUGS ('Applied: Invalid Date')
   - In JobApplicationsModal.jsx, EmployerDashboard.jsx, and all application/interview review modals: Fix date parsing logic. Safely handle ISO dates, SQL timestamps, Unix epochs, null, and undefined values. Under no circumstances may 'Invalid Date' appear anywhere in the rendered DOM.

5. CLUSTER 5: ACTION BUTTONS & MODAL STYLING UPGRADE
   - Candidate Review & Application Modals: Upgrade plain unstyled action buttons ('Download Resume', 'Send Email', 'Show Resume') to Cuba M3 styled buttons with sleek icons, proper hover transitions, contrast compliance, and disabled states.

### 3. AUTOMATED TESTING UPGRADE (ELIMINATING BLIND SPOTS)
   - Author comprehensive Playwright UAT suite (tests/e2e/dir048-uiux-polish.spec.js) that actively checks for visual excellence:
     a) Negative assertion: Rendered DOM must NEVER contain 'Invalid Date', 'NaN', 'undefined', or 'Status Unknown'.
     b) Dialog trap: page.on('dialog') must assert that NO native alert dialog is fired.
     c) Container margin/padding inspection: Evaluate bounding boxes of main dashboard containers across viewports (375px, 768px, 1280px, 1920px) to verify gutter compliance.
     d) Visual popup verification: Open UserMenu and NotificationCenter, verify Cuba glassmorphism classes, custom scrollbar styling, and z-index ordering.

### 4. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA & 99+/100 GATE
   - AC-1: Zero native window.alert() in entire client codebase.
   - AC-2: Zero 'Invalid Date' occurrences across all portals and modals.
   - AC-3: AI Engine status pill resolves to 'AI Engine Ready' in normal operational state.
   - AC-4: M3UserMenu and M3NotificationCenter redesigned to Cuba Glass standard with custom scrollbars and realistic notifications.
   - AC-5: Dashboard layouts across all 4 portals implement consistent responsive gutters and card margins.
   - AC-6: Playwright E2E visual and functional suite passes 100% with real-DOM screenshot evidence.
   - AC-7: Cognitive audit score >= 99/100 required before Gatekeeper certification.

### 5. CLUSTER 6: GOOGLE-INSPIRED LAYOUT RESTRUCTURING & DASHBOARD MISSING OPTIONS CENSUS
- Missing Options & Dead Controls Census: Audit every dashboard view across Candidate, Employer/Recruiter, Enterprise, and SuperAdmin portals. Identify all missing, unlinked, or dead control options (e.g. bulk actions, filter resets, export formats, resume preview options, application quick-actions, status toggles). Wire all options to real functional state or rich Cuba modals/toasts.
- Google-Inspired Material 3 Layout Architecture: Restructure all internal dashboard pages and portal views into Google-inspired executive layouts:
  a) Top Navigation Bar: Unified Google Cloud/Workspace style with floating identity chip, search palette (Cmd+K), presence indicators, and glassmorphic popovers.
  b) Responsive Container Gutters: Generous whitespace hierarchy, eliminating edge-to-edge stretching (max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 sm:py-8).
  c) Stat Cards & Data Widgets: Modern Google M3 tonal pastel surfaces, rounded-2xl elevation cards, trend indicators, and refined micro-interactions.
  d) Tab & Table Navigation: Google-style pill tabs, clean table dividers, and subtle hover highlights.
  e) Feedback & Overlays: Replace raw dialogs with Google M3 styled floating sheets, bottom sheets, and snackbars.

### 6. CLUSTER 7: ADAPTIVE NATIVE DEVICE EXPERIENCE (MOBILE APP & TABLET APP UX)
- Native Mobile App Experience (375px - 480px):
  a) Bottom Navigation Bar / App Bar: Mobile navigation docks cleanly at the bottom with quick access to Home/Overview, Jobs, Applications, and Profile.
  b) Bottom Sheet Overlays: All modals, filter menus, and action drawers on mobile open as native bottom sheets (rounded-t-3xl, swipe/drag indicator, backdrop blur) rather than desktop-centered boxes.
  c) Touch Ergonomics: Minimum 44x44px - 48x48px tap targets, zero horizontal overflow, and full touch-first fluidity.
  d) Streamlined Card Streams: Single-column feed with compact metric badges and floating action buttons (FAB) for primary creation actions.
- Native Tablet App Experience (768px - 1024px):
  a) Compact Navigation Rail: Slim collapsible icon sidebar maximizing horizontal canvas room for content.
  b) Adaptive Master-Detail / Split Views: Utilize screen real estate for list + preview split panes (e.g. job list on left, candidate review/job detail on right).
  c) Contextual Overlays: Floating contextual sheets and popovers positioned ergonomically for tablet touch interaction.

Real operational telemetry emitted by /api/service-availability with zero simulated provider status

plan.summary: DIR-048 reconnaissance complete across all 4 portals (candidate /dashboard, recruiter /employer, enterprise /org/:slug, superadmin /admin/dashboard). Verified root causes with file evidence: (1) native dialogs at 16 plus client sites - window.prompt in DashboardHomepage.jsx:553, PortfolioBuilder.jsx:790, EnterpriseAuditTab.jsx:192; alert() in JobApplicationsModal.jsx:77,82,431, EditJobModal.jsx:232, CreateJobModal.jsx:237,273,289,293, MainJobListings.jsx:466, RecoverPassword.jsx:32,53,68,77, Register.jsx:358, ReviewStep.jsx:76, BuildResume.jsx:1028,1101,1138,1185,1260. (2) JobApplicationsModal.formatDate line 138 has NO validity guard - exact source of Applied Invalid Date; three more literal Invalid date fallback strings at EmployerDashboard.jsx:363, CompaniesManagement.jsx:191,193, AppliedJobs.jsx:130. (3) AI beacon cannot leave AI Engine Status Unknown because platformHealth.js pins ai-providers to UNKNOWN when configured lines 440-446 and getServiceAvailability line 678 emits no ai block; useAiEngineStatus already consumes ai.providers or ai.available booleans. (4) M3UserMenu and M3NotificationCenter have solid a11y contracts but lack cuba-glass plus shadow-cuba-xl token missing plus custom scrollbar utilities none exist; backend/index.js:2324 hardcodes New message and You have a new message. (5) CubaAppShell wraps content in max-w-[1400px] px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 not max-w-7xl; sidebar is hidden below lg so 768-1024 tablet has NO rail; no bottom tab bar exists; legacy EmployerDashboard uses px-3 sm:px-4 lg:px-6 xl:px-8 without max-w. (6) dead control found - Download Resume button JobApplicationsModal line 411 has no onClick; action buttons are raw slate styles. Verified infra for execution: toast showToast available in all prompt-affected components, CubaModal and CubaDrawer primitives exist, hermetic Playwright pattern proven by dir047 config and universal-swot-uat.spec.js, live AI discovery stack available at backend/services/aiRouting. Zero state-changing actions taken in PLAN mode.
